name: Ferruginous-Donjon
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws impact-scarred wastelands, patient as erosion itself.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Debris from starship crash site (warship) rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
